summary: Focused frontend re-test of the 3 BulkImageUpload defect fixes from iteration_81 (Wave 105.10). Seeded ONE printer listing without image_url (TEST-UI-PR-M404) for the existing QA supplier so printers could be verified. ALL 3 FIXES VERIFIED PASS: (1) page now calls GET /api/supplier/printers/mine -> 200 and the photo-less printer appears alongside the photo-less toner, bulk-img-remaining = '2 listings without photos'; (2) after uploading to slot 0 the row STAYS visible, thumbnail renders, slots 1 and 2 remain visible/enabled and accepted a 2nd real upload (POST /supplier/printer-image 200 + PUT /supplier/printers/{id} 200) — the row only disappears after reload (2 rows -> 1 row, count 2 -> 1); (3) all slot testids are uniquely scoped bulk-img-slot-{rowId}-{0,1,2} — a full-page duplicate-testid scan found no duplicates for bulk-img-*. Regressions OK: toner rows (TEST-UI-HP-26A, TEST-UI-CN-052) render on dashboard, toner slot upload works, bulk-img-empty state renders once all listings have photos ('0 listings without photos'), /supplier dashboard loads with search + brand + max-price filter row and 'listing-filter-count = 3 of 3', no pageerror / console error / 4xx-5xx API calls on either page. Also confirmed 'Photo added' sonner toast DOES appear (iteration_81's missing-toast note was a test-timing artifact — 9s wait outran the 4s toast).
